outcome: metabolic outcomes (fasting total cholesterol, fasting LDL, glucose, insulin, HOMA-IR)
cohort: 90 obese pregnant Caucasian women diagnosed with early gestational diabetes mellitus.
finding: Lifestyle intervention in obese women with early GDM was not effective in improving overall obstetric or metabolic outcomes.
mod_finding: The lifestyle intervention group had a significantly higher rate of planned cesarean sections compared to the standard care group.
